instructions: You are routing a calendar assistant. Read the conversation and pick the ONE action the assistant should take next for the user's latest message.

tools.propose_blocks: Find free time for something. The user gave no clock time, or asked us to find when: "find time for gym this week", "2 hours tomorrow evening", "make it later".
tools.place_at: Book something at the exact clock time the user said, with a start and an end or length: "gym 6-8pm", "dentist friday 9:30 for 30 min", or a reply that picks a time.
tools.ask_clarification: Something needed is missing or unclear, so ask first: no day, no length, a time like "at 6" without am/pm, or not clear which event.
tools.find_events: Look up existing events: what is on a day, when something is, did something get booked.
tools.change_event: Move, reschedule or rename an event that already exists: "move gym to 7pm", "push the standup 30 min".
tools.delete_event: Cancel or remove an event that already exists: "cancel the dentist", "clear my afternoon".
tools.record_rule: A standing rule for the future, with words like always, never, every: "never book me before 10", "keep fridays free".
tools.block_time_off: The user will be away or unavailable for a stretch: vacation, trip, sick, day off, wedding.
tools.answer: Chat that needs no calendar action: thanks, greetings, why questions, things unrelated to the calendar.
